# GENERATED FILE. Edit tools/gen_xqol_phase2.py, then regenerate.

xqol_mass_conversion_courtier_interaction = {
	hidden = yes
	category = interaction_category_religion
	use_diplomatic_range = no
	ai_maybe = yes
	can_send_despite_rejection = yes
	ai_min_reply_days = 1
	ai_max_reply_days = 5
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = { is_ai = yes }
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:actor.faith != scope:recipient.faith
		scope:recipient = { is_courtier_of = scope:actor }
		scope:recipient = { is_ruler = no }
		scope:recipient = { is_imprisoned = no }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			is_adult = yes
		}
		valid_demand_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
	}

	ai_accept = {
		base = 0
		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 50
			desc = EDUCATE_CHILD_ACTOR_IS_MY_LIEGE
		}
		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes
	}

	on_accept = {
		xqol_mass_conversion_courtier_accepted_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		xqol_mass_conversion_declined_effect = yes
	}

}

xqol_mass_conversion_ruler_interaction = {
	hidden = yes
	category = interaction_category_religion
	use_diplomatic_range = no
	ai_maybe = yes
	can_send_despite_rejection = yes
	ai_min_reply_days = 4
	ai_max_reply_days = 9
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = { is_ai = yes }
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:puppet_or_actor ?= {
			NOT = { faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				target_is_liege_or_above = scope:puppet_or_actor
				is_tributary_of = scope:puppet_or_actor
			}
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			is_adult = yes
		}
		valid_demand_conversion_conditions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { scope:is_puppet_action ?= yes }
			scope:puppet_or_actor = {
				influence >= demand_conversion_influence_cost_value
			}
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:puppet_or_actor.domicile ?= {
					domicile_uses_culture_and_faith = yes
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					is_ruler = yes
					government_has_flag = government_is_in_steppe
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = nomads_must_inspire_tt
				always = no
			}
		}
	}

	ai_accept = {
		base = 0
		celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
			ACTOR = scope:puppet_or_actor
			RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
		}
		modifier = {
			add = 50
			desc = EDUCATE_CHILD_ACTOR_IS_MY_LIEGE
		}
		religion_demand_conversion_default_modifier = yes
		religion_demand_conversion_christian_situation_modifier = yes
	}

	on_accept = {
		xqol_mass_conversion_ruler_accepted_effect = yes
	}

	on_decline = {
		xqol_mass_conversion_declined_effect = yes
	}

}

xqol_release_hook_recruit_conversion_interaction = {
	hidden = yes
	common_interaction = no
	category = interaction_category_prison
	use_diplomatic_range = no
	ai_will_do = { base = 100 }

	is_shown = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			xqol_release_base_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_hook_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_recruit_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_conversion_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	is_valid = {
		scope:actor = { xqol_human_ruler_trigger = yes }
		scope:recipient = {
			xqol_release_base_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_hook_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_recruit_valid_trigger = yes
			xqol_release_conversion_valid_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	ai_accept = {
	base = 100
	celestial_hierarchy_acceptance_modifier = {
		ACTOR = scope:puppet_or_actor
		RECIPIENT = scope:recipient
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -20
		scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		desc = RECIPIENT_IS_AMBITIOUS
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -120
		scope:recipient = { rite.head_of_rite ?= this }
		desc = RECIPIENT_IS_HEAD_OF_RITE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -1500
		scope:recipient = { has_character_flag = ai_will_not_convert }
		desc = ASK_FOR_CONVERSION_RECIPIENT_WILL_NOT_ACCEPT
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -20
		scope:recipient = { ai_zeal <= 20 }
		desc = CONVERSION_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = {
			value = scope:recipient.ai_zeal
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient.faith = {
						faith_hostility_level = {
							target = scope:actor.faith
							value = faith_astray_level
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = -1
			}
			else = { multiply = -2 }
		}
		scope:recipient = { ai_zeal > 20 }
		desc = CONVERSION_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = {
			value = -50
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { ai_vengefulness > 0 } }
				subtract = scope:recipient.ai_vengefulness
			}
		}
		desc = GAIN_HOOK_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	modifier = {
		add = -10
		NOT = {
			scope:actor = {
				culture = { has_cultural_parameter = can_recruit_prisoners_easily }
			}
		}
		desc = RECRUITMET_NEGATIVE_REASON
	}
	}

	on_accept = {
		scope:actor = { save_scope_as = puppet_or_actor }
		xqol_release_prisoner_terms_effect = {
			HOOK = yes
			RECRUIT = yes
			CONVERSION = yes
		}
	}

}
